title: Align a supported PVC-U pipe joint and insert two bolts
instruction: Hold the supported pipe joint aligned by gripping the bare pipe, and insert two bolts horizontally in the two upper flange holes.
context: Bench fabrication: a supported real pipe spool must be clocked and slid into flange alignment while an eccentric elbow branch requires the bare-pipe grip to resist roll during horizontal bolt insertion. No added grasp lug.
setup: GF 721730208 d32/DN25 PVC-U fixed socket flanges: 115 mm OD, 85 mm bolt circle, four 14 mm bores and 14 mm plates. GF 161017108 pipe: 32 mm OD, 2.4 mm wall, 430 mm moving cut and 200 mm fixed cut. Moving GF 721100108 elbow and 200 mm branch; 444.61 g catalog-derived spool mass. Four metal V rests, fixed-pipe straps and branch reset block. Bare 32 mm pipe grip. Two DIN 931 M12x50 A2-70 bolts: 19 mm AF, 7.5 mm heads, 63.2 g ideal solid-envelope mass estimate; threads/chamfers omitted. Exact mounting/reset in README.
scoring: Final 0.4 for opposed horizontal axes within 7.25 degrees and all four mating holes within 3 mm. Add 0.3 per distinct upper bolt fitting the actual 32-sided shaft/bore polygons at both ends of both 14 mm plates, with 50 micrometre numerical contact tolerance, head gap at most 3 mm (0.5 mm penetration tolerance), and tip projection at least 2 mm. Held pipe can score; no unsupported joint-load or seal claim.
reset_notes: Restore the supported spool to minus 15-degree roll and 24.5 mm initial face gap, with its branch on the reset block. Both arms ready/open; two bolts on stands; no jitter. Inspect and clean real parts, verify mass/dimensions and cured solvent joints. No added grip feature.
fidelity: Commercial PVC-U spool dimensions and catalog-derived mass replace the lugged prop. Rigid envelopes and approximate inertia; blunt smooth bolts omit threads/chamfers. Friction and physical forces are unmeasured; no physical build. Board demo combines synchronized station and fixture views of one run; Dream uses its native station view.
